mentions.name: Manabrew
mentions.description: Web app for playing Magic: the Gathering games locally in the browser, powered by the MTG Forge Java rules engine compiled to WebAssembly using GraalVM's new WebAssembly support.
mentions.source_excerpt: GraalVM’s new WebAssembly support finally made this possible, and we now use it for local games in Manabrew.
